(u4, else) -> u4

(u1, has_matching_key, u2) -> 0.2
(u2, target_door_open, u3) -> 0.2
(u3, target_picked_up, u4) -> 0.4
feedback: The RM captures the ordering find key -> hold key -> open door -> pick up ball and is compact and safe, but has defects. 1) Persistence/format: FINAL_STATES lists u4, which is declared in STATES, so the header is present, but the self-loop (u4, else) -> u4 is fine only if the episode terminates on pickup; MiniGrid does terminate, so this is acceptable. 2) Regression coverage: the task requires 'the locked door must be open on the last step'. has_matching_key and target_door_open can turn false (drop the key, toggle the door shut), but the RM treats target_door_open as if it persists: in u3, a transition on target_door_open -> u3 keeps the agent in u3 even if the door is later closed, so the agent could close the door after opening it and still earn the final pickup reward. u3 must gate progress on the door staying open (e.g. require !target_door_open to regress to u2 with a negative/zero reward), since target_picked_up cannot become true before target_door_open but target_door_open itself can flip. 3) Reachability of the last-step requirement: the RM gives no penalty or regression for dropping the key in u2 (u2 else stays u2, fine since the door cannot open without the key being held at toggle time), but after entering u3 nothing enforces that the door is open at the pickup step; combined with item 2 this means the machine does not faithfully encode 'door open on the last step'. 4) Transition (u1, has_matching_key & !key_found) -> u1 is dead weight: has_matching_key cannot become true before key_found (constraint in the environment), and since key_found is a latch, once in u1 key_found is always true, so the condition !key_found can never hold; it is harmless but semantically misleading and should be removed for compactness. 5) Reward density: progress rewards are bounded and only on progress edges, fine. 6) Irrelevant events: per-state else self-loops cover all unmodeled propositions, fine. Fix the u3 regression issue (allow target_door_open to turn false and return to u2) and remove the unreachable u1 edge to satisfy fidelity and compactness.

Format check: header includes a nonempty FINAL_STATES declaration (u4), and all declared states (u0-u4) are used in transitions and rewards. Semantic fidelity: the propositions used (key_found, has_matching_key, target_door_open, target_picked_up) are all defined in the domain and the ordering constraints hold: u0->u1 requires key_found (the true 'located' reading, view-based latch); u1->u2 requires has_matching_key (guaranteed possible only after key_found per environment constraints); u2->u3 requires target_door_open (which cannot occur before has_matching_key per constraints, so reaching u3 implies the key was carried); u3->u4 requires target_picked_up (which cannot occur before target_door_open per constraints, so reaching u4 implies the door was open on that step). Regressions: (u3, !target_door_open) -> u2 with reward -0.2 correctly handles the door being closed again after being opened (possible per the environment: 'has_matching_key and target_door_open can turn false again'), pushing the agent back to u2 to re-open it. Predicate-only events: all transition labels use only the defined propositions and the reserved 'else'/'!' (negation) forms; no raw action names or illegal events. Irrelevant events coverage: every state has an 'else' self-loop covering all unlabeled proposition combinations, so unlisted events (turns, moves, toggles of other doors, etc.) are safely absorbed without state changes or rewards. Reward safety: rewards are dense in the sense of marking each required milestone (0.1, 0.2, 0.2, 1.0) but bounded; the -0.2 regression penalty is modest and appropriately discourages door-shutting without dominating the 1.0 terminal reward. Ordered transition coverage: the key_found->has_matching_key->target_door_open->target_picked_up chain matches the task ordering 'open the door before picking up the ball'; u4 is terminal-accepting (self-loop on else), and since target_picked_up coincides with episode end, no post-terminal hazards arise. No issues found.
